courses.title: BBA in Hospital Management
courses.eligibility: 10+2 passed in any stream from recognized Board
courses.shortDesc: Comprehensive program preparing leaders for the burgeoning healthcare and hospital administrative sectors.
courses.fullDesc: CIMS College is recognized as one of the premier Hospital Management institutes in West Bengal. The BBA in Hospital Management equips students with strategic operational skills, patient care administration, healthcare finance, hospital information systems (HIS), and NABH accreditation protocols.
highlights: Rigorous hospital clinical rotations & administrative internships
Practical exposure at City Hospital & leading multispecialty chains
100% placement assistance in leading hospitals across India

courses.title: B.Sc in Hospitality & Hotel Administration
courses.eligibility: 10+2 in any stream from recognized Board
courses.shortDesc: World-class hospitality training encompassing culinary arts, front office operations, food & beverage, and hotel management.
courses.fullDesc: Step into the vibrant global hospitality industry with CIMS. Acclaimed as the leading Hospitality and Hotel Management college in West Bengal, CIMS combines rigorous practical kitchen labs, simulated front desk suites, mock bar setups, and mandatory 6-month industrial internships in 5-star luxury hotels.
highlights: Industrial training in luxury 5-star brand hotels (Taj, Marriott, Hyatt)
Hands-on Food Production, Bakery & International Culinary Labs
Wine tasting, banquet management & mixology workshops
careerProspects: Aviation & Cabin Crew / Cruise Line Executive

courses.title: Allied Health Sciences & Paramedical (BMLT / BMRIT / BOTT)
courses.shortDesc: High-demand clinical paramedical programs delivering hands-on pathology, radiology imaging, and operation theatre expertise.
courses.fullDesc: Allied Health professionals are the backbone of modern healthcare delivery. CIMS Paramedical College in West Bengal provides advanced clinical exposure in BMLT (Medical Lab Technology), BMRIT (Medical Radiology & Imaging), and BOTT (Operation Theatre Technology) backed by modern diagnostic laboratories and daily clinical rotations.
highlights: Real clinical rotations in active hospital pathology & diagnostic wings
Advanced automated biochemistry, microbiology & hematology analyzers
Comprehensive training in digital X-ray, CT Scan & MRI protocols
High placement rate in diagnostic centres, government & private hospitals

courses.title: BCA - Bachelor of Computer Applications
courses.eligibility: 10+2 with Mathematics / Computer Science / Statistics / Information Practices
courses.shortDesc: Cutting-edge computing education in software engineering, cloud computing, web development, and modern AI algorithms.
courses.fullDesc: The BCA program at CIMS College empowers aspiring tech leaders with robust programming foundations, modern cloud computing architectures, full-stack web and mobile development, and data analytics. Equipped with high-tech computer labs and industry live-project mentorship.
highlights: Modern high-speed computing lab with latest dev stacks
Hands-on projects in Python, Java, React, Next.js, and Cloud
Campus placement drives with leading IT and consulting firms
Tech hackathons, code sprints, and certifications

news.title: Admissions Open for 2026-27 Academic Session: Hospital Management & Hospitality
news.summary: Applications are officially invited for BBA Hospital Management, B.Sc Hospitality, Paramedical and BCA programs for July 2026 batch.
news.content: Cambridge Institute of Management Studies (CIMS Group) invites applications for admission into its flagship undergraduate and diploma courses for the 2026-27 academic session. Early applicants are eligible for special institutional merit scholarships and education loan assistance.

news.title: Sky-High Careers: Hospital Management & Healthcare Industry Outlook 2026
news.summary: Healthcare administration continues to be one of India's fastest-growing employment sectors with rising demand for NABH certified executives.
news.content: With the dramatic expansion of super-specialty hospitals, health tech ecosystems, and medical tourism hubs in Eastern India, graduates in Hospital Management enjoy unprecedented career growth.

news.title: Annual Hospital & 5-Star Hotel Internship Placement Drive Concludes
news.summary: Over 95% of the final year batch secured paid industrial training and internship placements in premier luxury hotels and hospital chains.
news.content: CIMS Training & Placement Cell proudly announces successful completion of the winter placement cycle. Students secured placements in Apollo Hospitals, Fortis, Marriott, and The Taj Group.

news.title: Notice Regarding Swami Vivekananda Merit-cum-Means Scholarship Verification
news.summary: Eligible students are requested to submit their scholarship renewal documents at the college registrar desk before the deadline.
news.content: All enrolled students eligible for state and institutional scholarships under Swami Vivekananda Foundation are notified to verify their documentation at the campus academic office.
